callees.name: os.path.isabs
callees.post_condition: Returns True when path designates an absolute path on the current platform (begins with a root directory), and False when path is relative.

callees.name: os.path.join
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a directory path string. path is a relative path string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a single path string formed by concatenating proj_dir and path with the platform-appropriate path separator between them.

callees.name: os.path.relpath
callees.pre_condition: absolute_path is an absolute path string. proj_dir is a directory path string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a relative path string expressing absolute_path relative to proj_dir. The result contains no leading path separator. Dot-dot (..) segments may appear at the start when absolute_path is not under proj_dir.

callees.name: os.path.normpath
callees.post_condition: Returns a normalized path string: single-dot (.) segments are removed, each double-dot (..) segment cancels the preceding non-dot-dot path component, and consecutive path separators are collapsed to a single separator.

callees.name: os.path.normcase
callees.post_condition: Returns a case-normalized version of relative_path. On case-insensitive filesystems, characters are lowercased. On case-sensitive filesystems, the path is returned unchanged.
